items.html: And know that those two mochin — the Bina and Gevura of ZA, which departed in the NNH of Bina — are the ones that entered the head of the Nukva itself. For Hochma and the Hasadim remained in the aspect of Makif for ZA; and these are the Gevurot that the Nukva took at the time of the sawing by Ima alone, as mentioned elsewhere. See there well.
